_comment: V3 plan. Same two B-roll cutaways and the same wipe-over-every-cut policy as v2, re-indexed and re-timed for the removal of P1: every segment index drops by one and every absolute time drops by 5.80s. The one genuine deletion is v2's extra wipe at 5.80 -- that was the P1->P2 cut, which no longer exists.
_boundaries_note: Segment durations are 4.37 / 6.45 / 3.10 / 6.35 = 20.27, so the segment openings are 0.00 / 4.37 / 10.82 / 13.92. B-roll splices into the START of a segment (out = broll[0:dur] + seg_video[dur:]), which is why those times are both the boundary and the splice start. Segment 0 opens the reel, so it has no cut and no wipe.
_searchmg_note: Still at the top of the P3a segment, now index 1 at 4.37-5.97, over 'Is the Just Ask Expo by PFEC Global' -- the query typing itself out on screen lands on the same words in the audio ('Just' 5.049, 'Ask' 5.429, 'Expo' 5.809-6.350). The splice can only start at a segment opening, so it begins 0.68s ahead of the phrase, exactly as in v1/v2. prep_searchmg.py needs no changes: it produces a fixed 1.6s asset independent of where it lands.
_broll1_note: Still at the top of the P3c segment, now index 3 at 13.92-18.37, covering the connecting phrase 'There will be' plus the three-role list it introduces, and returning in the 0.06s gap before 'There will be a real conversation' (18.429) so he closes on camera. broll.py needs no timing changes either: its card cues are LOCAL to the splice, and because P3c keeps its original keep range the words still land at local 0.909 / 2.329 / 3.189 exactly as before.
_wipes_note: Three cuts, three wipes, no two adjacent the same: speed(4.37) -> grid(10.82) -> flash(13.92). 4.37 and 13.92 are B-roll boundaries and those default to grid, so boundary_wipes names speed and flash explicitly; neither appears in extra_wipes, because a boundary already emits its own wipe and listing it twice would stack two on one frame. v2's fourth wipe (flash at 5.80) is gone with the cut it masked.
